subject: Private offer: 2-yr term & pricing for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Tom Bolton <tom.bolton@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer request — 2yr term and pricing

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo earlier — NovaHealth is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. Procurement asked me to open a private-offer conversation so we can align on term, discount and approvals. High level:

- We prefer a 24-month commitment (start date target 2027-05-01).
- Looking for a ~25% discount off list for a committed annual usage profile (~$420k/yr).
- Procurement will issue an AWS private offer / PO; final signoff needs CFO + Procurement lead.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a 24-month term at that discount and what internal approvals we should expect on your side? Also attaching our SOW for context.

Attaching: NovaHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, non-sensitive)

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Procurement Manager
NovaHealth Systems
alyssa.chen@novahealth.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request — 2yr term and pricing

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Appreciate the timeline. Short answer: we can support a 24-month private offer but the discount tier and payment schedule affect internal approvals. Options to consider:

1) Standard 24-month pricing (up to 20% off list) — Sales Manager approval only, rolling monthly consumption invoicing.
2) 24-month with 22–25% discount — requires Director/Finance signoff and a minimum annual commitment (we'd need ~$400k/yr minimum) and annual prepay is preferred.
3) 18-month hybrid — slightly higher effective price than (2) but fewer approval gates and faster turnaround.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm whether NovaHealth can do annual prepayment vs. monthly invoicing.
- If prepay, Marcus (Finance) can approve up to 22% for 24 months; >22% will need elevated signoff.
- If you want us to route as co-sell, confirm the AWS rep so we can create the private-offer through the proper co-sell path.

I attached our internal pricing guide for reference. If you can confirm payment cadence and AWS rep, I’ll loop in finance and legal to expedite.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Pricing_GUIDE_v3.pdf

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (650) 555-0142

Vanessa, Alyssa — tagging in a couple of quick operational notes from GTM/legal side: 

- Approval gates: Sales Director signoff required for discounts >20%. Finance involvement required for multi-year prepay schedules.
- Legal review: any contract >12 months with annual prepay needs standard payment schedule and termination language changed (we’ll prepare redlines).
- Co-sell: to route to AWS marketplace co-sell we need the AWS rep's email + partner opportunity ID. If co-sell is in play, fill that in so I can route the private-offer correctly (otherwise it will be a standard private offer).

Proposed quick timeline:
- Confirm payment cadence by COB Mon 4/5.
- If prepay + 24 months and annual commit meets finance minimum, Marcus will fast-track approval.

I can prepare the initial private-offer draft once Vanessa confirms internal discount ceiling.

Cheers,

Quick note from finance: we can approve a 22% discount for a 24-month term under these conditions:

- Annual minimum committed spend >= $400k/yr (meets Alyssa's signal).
- Annual prepayment or a guaranteed ACH schedule with a parent company guarantee.
- We’ll require a short revenue schedule and collection milestone (I attached a stub).

If NovaHealth confirms annual prepay and the $400k floor, I’ll sign off and instruct Sales Ops to open the private offer in AWS console. For >22%, this moves to VP Finance approval and will likely add 3–5 business days.

Attachment: finance_term_schedule.xlsx
